guessart.manualWordModeDesc: Players enter their own custom words instead of picking from the catalogue.
guessart.addSynonymTooltip: Save as synonym for this word
guessart.shareLinksDesc: Players can join on their own device via QR code or invite link.
guessart.waitingForDrawerDescLocalGuesser: Once {{name}} has finished drawing, your guessing round will start directly here!
guessart.waitingForDrawerDescSpectator: {{drawer}} is currently drawing for {{guesser}}. The game will proceed once the drawing is finished.
guessart.temporaryTurnDesc: Local only for this turn – reverts to remote afterwards
guessart.playersSetupDesc: Add at least 2 players. You can play together on one device or join with individual links.
guessart.roomNeedTwo: At least 2 players are needed in the lobby.
guessart.liveDesc: Everyone plays at the same time: invite players to the lobby, the host starts.
guessart.overDaysDesc: Play over days: add the players below and send each one their own link.
guessart.garticShortDesc: Live Multiplayer: Write phrase ➔ Draw ➔ Guess ➔ Album reveal show!
guessart.rulesIntro: GuessArt is a local pass-and-play drawing and guessing game for 2 or more players.
guessart.step1Desc: The active drawer picks a word from a category (or enters a custom word) and draws it on the canvas.
guessart.step2Desc: Pass the device to the other players. The drawing is replayed animatedly while players guess.
guessart.step3Desc: When stuck, the hint button reveals word structure and letter pools to assist guessing.
guessart.historySubtitle: Past drawings & rounds of this game
guessart.switchToRemote: Switch to remote ({{name}} plays on another device)
guessart.editGameSubtitle: Adjust the game name and player names.
guessart.editProfileSubtitle: Adjust your player name or local game name.
guessart.catalogueEditorSubtitle: Customize categories & words locally or publish via GitHub Pull Request
guessart.confirmResetCatalogue: Really reset to default catalogue? Custom changes will be lost.
guessart.catNamesRequired: Names in German and English are required.

guessart.canonicalNamesRequired: Canonical term in German and English is required!
guessart.publishDesc: Automatically create a GitHub Pull Request with your local categories and words. The repository admin can review and merge them.
